title: BPR (Bureau of Public Roads) Congestion Model Parameters
description: Calibration parameters for travel time estimation under congestion conditions

bpr_model.formula_description: Travel time equals free-flow time multiplied by congestion factor

v.name: Traffic volume
v.note: Must be in PCU units; convert mixed traffic using vehicle_pcu_factors

c.name: Road capacity
c.note: Design capacity from road classification and lane count

alpha.name: Shape parameter
alpha.description: Controls how steeply congestion increases with volume/capacity ratio
alpha.notes: Standard BPR value used internationally; YUTRA does not provide local calibration

beta.name: Power exponent
beta.description: Controls the curve shape; higher β = sharper congestion response
beta.notes: Standard BPR exponent; characteristic value for urban traffic

validation_range.notes: Model is valid for v/c from 0 (free-flow) to 1.2 (oversaturation). Beyond 1.2, behavior is unpredictable (queuing, gridlock).

example_calculations.result: Minimal delay; only 4% increase over free-flow

calibration_notes.source: Standard BPR model (not locally calibrated for Yangon)
calibration_notes.applicability: Applicable when volume and capacity data are available from traffic surveys
limitations: Does not account for signalized intersection delays (see signal_delay_observations for traffic light timing)
Assumes continuous flow; does not model queue buildup from stop-start traffic
Parameters are averages; variation by time-of-day is not captured
Special events (accidents, protests, festivals) cause unpredictable deviations

provenance.source: YUTRA Volume II: Yangon Urban Traffic and Road Assessment
provenance.model_source: Bureau of Public Roads (USA), standard international traffic engineering reference
provenance.notes: YUTRA applies standard BPR model with global parameters; does not provide Yangon-specific calibration of α and β
